name: NetworkLab
title: Network Lab
about: Networking with real requests to the free JSONPlaceholder test API: HTTP and URLs, REST and JSON decoding, URLSession with async/await, errors, retries and security, WebSockets and streaming, and a testable API layer.
notes: Most demos need an internet connection. Each one shows a readable error and a Retry button when you are offline.
JSONPlaceholder answers POST, PATCH and DELETE but does not store anything.
Push notifications need the paid Apple Developer Program, so the push demo starts in a labeled simulated mode.
